args.title: Juniper Labware: Cold-chain logistics in 2026 — summary
args.body:
Combined summary of the Juniper Labware newsletter, its linked article, and the companion piece:

• Newsletter: This week's Juniper Labware newsletter covers cold-chain logistics in 2026, pointing readers to the main article and a subscriber-only companion piece with full charts.
• Article (blog.juniper.example/2026/cold-chain): Temperature excursions fell 30% where carriers shared live sensor data, and most savings came from fewer rejected loads rather than reduced spoilage.
• Companion piece (insights.juniper.example/cold-chain/companion): Pilots cut claims by a quarter.
